summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing UK-style PDMR dealing disclosures, the US equivalent of Form 4 insider transaction reports. Three managers, including CFO Srinivas Phatak, reported dividend reinvestment into ordinary 3.5p shares on 2026-09-23: Phatak acquired 451.18 PLC shares at GBP47.14262 and 34.21 EUR shares at EUR54.8102; Campanella and Ecclissato reported similar reinvestments. No stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural terms appear. This is routine compensation-related share activity, not a special situation; watch only for cumulative insider ownership drift.
